godot.aide:
Left click or box: select   Shift: add
Double click: whole type on screen   Esc: deselect   Ctrl+A: all
Right click: order   Ctrl+1 to 9: store   1 to 9: recall (twice: centre)
WASD, arrows, screen edge: scroll   wheel: zoom   middle button: rotate
F1 to F4: cameras   F5: edit the scenario   F6: edit the terrain
Space: start, pause   + and -: speed   N: new game
C: coverages   B: fog   M: sound   L: language   H: this help
